lines.text: But before we could leave, the woman had come outside again. In the lamplight we could see that she had something heavy in her arms. She looked around to see if anybody was following her. Then there was a loud bang as she dropped the box on the stone steps. She was so busy that she didn't notice the two of us walking up behind her. Marta stepped in front of her and she stopped suddenly. Omar and I quietly moved closer to help Marta. I had a torch ready and soon it was impossible for the woman to get away.
lines.how: Read this short story aloud at a natural storytelling pace, linking the words smoothly as a native speaker does.
